title: skills: objectstack-ui and objectstack-data still teach a primary related list's "own tab" and an unbounded relatedLists refusal after the spec describes moved (#27352)
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 from the os-dev-report of PR #27352 (#27311 + #27312, comment 6486061826), out-of-scope finding (1), class b, named producer. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

## Observed (on `origin/main`)

PR #27352 rewrites the spec's `.describe()` text for related lists and `trackHistory` to what the runtime does. Two governed skills pages still teach the old text, and PR #27352 cannot touch them (`skills/**` is a governed path):

1. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:109-121` says a `relatedList: 'primary'` child gets its **own tab** on the tabbed page, and that the synthesized page's layout is one tab per primary list plus a shared Related tab. On the v3 record page (PR #27310) a primary list is a full-width body table in the details column, after its first field section, with no tab of its own.
2. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:347-353` says the same "own tab", and "a name matching no inbound FK is refused" with no boundary. The enforced boundary (`validate-related-list-refs` header, seat ruling A on #27311): a child in the stack with no inbound FK is refused everywhere; a child that exists nowhere is refused by `os validate` / `os build` and by a metadata write that names no package; a write into a package stores it, and the page places nothing.

## Wanted

Both pages say what PR #27352's describes say, after #27310 and #27352 land. Check the skills token ratchet per file.

## Dedupe words

skills relatedList primary own tab History tab relatedLists refused package closure
